stateNote: Cook: If using an Instant Pot, put the lid on, and cook on high for 45 minutes. Once done, unplug the pot, and do a natural release. If using the stove, bring the pot to a boil, cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer until the meat easily shreds. It should take about 1½–2 hours. Add more water if it gets too dry.
